rows.dev_effect: MPNet was selected against the current R1 SM backend by the pre-registered method-neutral objective.
rows.evidence: Existing R1 diagnostic reported Ours action mapping 61/93 with SM versus 82/93 with MD; the final run exposes the same action-mapping gap.
rows.proposed_fix: Promote a shared, local, Gold-blind MPNet backend using the model's declared mean-token pooling and L2 normalization.
rows.root_cause: The small spaCy model has no static word vectors and only weak context tensors; shared action matching lacked a sentence-level semantic encoder.
rows.symptom: Frozen R1 spaCy SM semantic backend under-mapped action predicates and left a large missing-action bottleneck.

rows.dev_effect: Not changed; kept frozen to avoid an unlicensed second refinement.
rows.evidence: The final selected run still has low missing-action precision for both methods; no obligation-scope revision was needed to remove the interface failure.
rows.proposed_fix: If a future authorized run shows the same systematic fragment pattern, apply at most one shared ObligationScopedActionProjection revision.
rows.root_cause: Stage-2 action spans sometimes contain subordinate fragments (e.g. prepositional continuations) and non-core clause actions; the denominator is not obligation-scoped.
rows.symptom: Missing-action precision remains low because extra/fragment Stage-2 actions are scored as mandatory obligations.

rows.evidence: Selected run coverage and unknown rates are reported separately; actor formula was not changed.
rows.proposed_fix: No formula change. Preserve Definition 6 and report coverage.
rows.root_cause: Definition 6 is intentionally action-bound; Stage-2 actor-action maps are incomplete for some records, so the cell is legitimately unknown rather than guessed.
rows.symptom: Actor coverage and unknown rate remain uneven, especially for Sun.

rows.dev_effect: Order F1 moved from interface-missing zero to 0.5 for both methods on the capability-aligned development scope.
rows.evidence: Frozen Sun/Ours order_relations were empty; new SharedRuleOrderAdapterV3 generated non-empty edges for R5-D-01/R5-D-02 Sun and for the R5-S4-T3 supplement for both methods.
rows.proposed_fix: Implement one documented, Gold-blind, method-neutral SharedRuleOrderAdapterV3 using temporal markers, general syntax, existing Stage-2 actions, and the shared matcher.
rows.root_cause: Sun's paper requires U_r subset A_r x A_r but does not publish an automatic extraction algorithm; the project had no shared U_r adapter.
rows.symptom: Sun/Ours frozen Stage-2 records had empty order_relations, so Definition 7 always had denominator zero.

rows.dev_effect: Unknown order cells are reported instead of setting F1 to zero through spurious edges.
rows.evidence: Adapter audits show no unique existing action pair for those requirements; they are retained in the eligibility report as outside/diagnostic rather than deleted.
rows.proposed_fix: Capability-aligned order eligibility; keep them as diagnostics. Do not invent nominal-to-action endpoints.
rows.root_cause: Frozen Stage-2 A_r does not contain the second endpoint (e.g. approving, informing, lifted) for R5-S7-T1/R5-S8-T1 and some nominalized cases.
rows.symptom: Several source temporal relations have a nominalized or absent second action and cannot satisfy U_r subset A_r x A_r.

rows.dev_effect: Ours order recall remains limited on existing cases; supplement gives an observable order signal.
rows.evidence: Final order rows show Sun edges for D-01/D-02 but Ours denominator zero; this is the intended method comparison, not an adapter bug.
rows.proposed_fix: Do not post-hoc repair Ours. A future authorized Stage-2 run may cover it; the final unseen run must not tune on this development result.
rows.root_cause: Ours extracts the `provide ... prior to further processing` predicate as one action and does not separately extract `process`; this is a Stage-2 representation coverage gap.
rows.symptom: Ours has no order edge for R5-D-01/R5-D-02 because its Stage-2 A_r lacks a process endpoint.
